description: MyMidlist is a leading online business directory dedicated exclusively to the Middle East, built to help customers discover trusted, verified businesses across the region and help businesses grow their digital visibility — for free. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in the UAE, MyMidlist covers eight countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan, and Turkey, spanning over ten business categories across diverse industries.
